original_ai_output.title_zh: 埃邦伊州专员否认其弟之死出于政治动机
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚埃邦伊州项目监测与评估专员Sunday Inyima否认其弟Egeonu Inyima遭谋杀一事出于政治动机，称相关说法具有误导性、虚假且系捏造。他在阿巴卡利基发表声明称，其弟未与任何人存在政治纠纷，并谴责据称散布未经证实说法的人。目前该事件为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 埃邦伊州专员Sunday Inyima否认其弟Egeonu Inyima遭谋杀出于政治动机
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Ebonyi State Commissioner for Project Monitoring and Evaluation, Chief Sunday Inyima, has dismissed insinuations that the brutal murder of his younger brother, Mr. Egeonu Inyima, was politically motivated.

key_facts.fact: 他在阿巴卡利基发表声明，称相关说法具有误导性、虚假且系捏造
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He described such claims as misleading, false and fabricated in a statement on Tuesday in Abakaliki.

key_facts.fact: 他谴责据称散布未经证实说法的人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He condemned those allegedly spreading unverified accounts of the incident

uncertainties: 谋杀动机尚未确认，政治动机说法被指为未经证实
事件目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
